facts.business: Go Fashion (India) Limited, through its flagship Go Colors brand, is one of India's leading branded women's bottomwear companies engaged in the design, development, sourcing, marketing and retailing of a comprehensive portfolio of bottomwear across ethnic, western, fusion, athleisure and occasion wear segments.

segments.name: Value-added non-leggings (trousers, palazzos, joggers, treggings, jeggings, athleisure and fusion wear)
